workflows.title: Research and evidence review
workflows.boundary: Graph/source discovery and source review; ingestion and graph promotion remain internal.

workflows.title: Resolve an organization
workflows.boundary: Identity and observed records; rich profile hydration and durable session state are not implied.

workflows.title: Design peers and compare funding
workflows.boundary: Source-checked cohort reasoning and selected-peer reads; no automatic national screen or approved cohort.

workflows.title: Issue to organizations and support
workflows.boundary: Candidate issue/program routes and purpose-text research; verify program, geography and actual funding purpose separately.

workflows.title: Check organization and funder relevance
workflows.boundary: Candidate review and source-backed classification; no automatic program verification, complete landscape, scored prospect ranking or graph promotion.

workflows.title: Studies, programs and fundable pilots
workflows.boundary: Original-source study and participant review uses native host research; no automatic paper-to-program graph join.

workflows.title: Funder fit and access review
workflows.boundary: Native official-source currentness, fit, donor/public bridge and instrument checks; no external-search provider, automated scoring or live RFP corpus promise.

workflows.title: Fundraising strategy and owned roadmap
workflows.boundary: Eleven-stage decision method; no strategy application state, typed engine or automatic monitoring.

workflows.title: Proposal and board research packet
workflows.boundary: Reviewed artifact drafting with native document tools when available; local generators and batch pipelines are not exposed.

internal_skills.reason: Maintains internal runtime/use-case registries and writeback plans; user-facing evidence review is in azimuth-research.
Product UI and backend contract design.
Operator document processing and queue writes.
Operator profile, embedding, QA and graph refresh jobs.
Internal warehouse schema/query guidance, not arbitrary SQL access.
Access administration and deployment; not a research action.
